capabilities: Assign custom images as icons to folders and notes
Upload and manage a local icon library with rename and delete
Insert inline :ci-NAME: icon shortcodes with autocomplete
Annotate individual inline icons with Markdown notes
Pick icons via a searchable picker with keyboard navigation
extras: Data, BRAT subscriptions, and hotkeys do not transfer from the predecessor plugins; a migration guide is required to keep icons and assignments. A sample vault is included in the repository. Requires Obsidian 1.5.7+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use your own images as icons in the file explorer, tabs, note titles, or inside note text.

relations.evidence: Version 3.0.0 is a separate installation from both Folder Fairy 2.x (icon-studio)

summary: Icon manager that assigns your own PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG images as icons for folders, notes, tabs, note titles, and inline shortcodes.
